column2: This is a mana ability, which means it can be activated as part of the process of casting a spell or activating another ability.
column3: Superseded: under the current CR 605.1a an ability whose effect draws a card (moves a card from a library) is not a mana ability, and the Eggs now read "(Activate only as an instant.)"; their abilities use the stack (tested in tests/rulings/r_s22_mana_abilities.rs)
